qualification:
Actual SDK shared acquire/drop write-set contract.
Checks that the complete SDK operation writes only the signed counter cell,
so arbitrary account-buffer contents need no giant symbolic-index query.
Not a whole-stage contract or a source replacement.
rc_counter_domain: Both data and lamport Rc strong counts1..isizeMAX; internal weak counts1..isizeMAX, public weak=internal-1. Compiler-layout header validated before injection.
domain: All signed counters, full58295-byte symbolic storage, view length0..58295, every account metadata/lamport value. Compiler-specific counter location validated before injection.
contract: Only counter.cast::<isize>() may be assigned; counter restored on return. Exact original SDK acquire and guard drop execute; acquisition mode explicitly recorded.
remaining: Need actual enclosing source composition; no whole S2 closure.
